# Version 6.10.0 of Retro Rewind has now been released! 
This update has a **TON **of brand new changes and additions so I heavily advise taking a look over at the change log below!

# 🏁 Gameplay Updates 🏁
```- The Custom Character setting has been replaced with a character selection button toggle! Alongside this, there is now 80+ custom skins AND custom characters that can be used! This implementation is inspired by CTGP-7's approach! 
- Mii Outfit C has been added to the character roster! You can unlock Mii Outfit C by reaching 30,000vr!```
